semantic.justification: Represented RTF paragraph and character items use upstream-shaped attribute output; complete source parity remains unverified. Native WriteNativeCharacter now delegates original associated-group ordering rather than emitting only Western fonts. Basic underline keywords move to the source association stage while non-associated underline color remains before it. All three native language values are emitted in their original families. Source caller collection uses a temporary actual set without mutating the borrowed input; native run script/bidi production and full paragraph-marker/general-property owners remain open. Native non-associated OutputCharFontAssoc updates the actual RtfExport current encoding through FontMapExport and checked font charset selection, with original unknown-to-default fallback; associated font output leaves encoding unchanged. Native RunText ignores its supplied charset and delegates RawText/OutString using current export encoding. RTF text uses represented GetSnippet substitutions; style names and hyperlink values use OutString. FontFamilyType, FontPitchType, FontCharset, StartFont, FontAlternateName and EndFont write to the actual export SvStream. Associated font controls now borrow the complete SvxFontItem rather than only its name. S3HW1E RTF numbering-table integration: actual GetNumberingId pointer identity and the InitFontTable used-rule snapshot replace the separate name-keyed RTF list map. Original abstract/instance loops emit nine Word levels or one continuous level, including the actual outline owner. Source level preparation preserves ListFormat UTF16 placeholders, separator suppression, unsupported level10 handling, unsigned-byte positions and signed16 geometry; RtfAttributeOutput writes original NFC/CJK-language, alignment, start, legal, follow, font/character properties and destinations. The browser command-rule assembler now supplies level-specific ListFormat instead of creating deprecated patternless numeric levels. Original character color/underline visitors run before header serialization to admit numbering-style colors; native accumulated automatic-style vector order and shared-handle release are preserved. New owned item sets are disposed. WRITER198 records retained adjacent separators. Common numbering preparation is currently bound to the actual RTF virtual output; full common AttributeOutputBase/DOCX numbering, graphic brush ownership, paragraph numbering/restart temporary-rule lifetimes, character-style table/cache and complete OutColorTable responsibilities remain unverified. This source-bound focused integration does not certify full upstream parity or filter completeness.
